title: 第402章 瞧不上
slug: 离婚当天前夫小叔连夜抢我领证
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

换作以前，林见微或许还会耐着性子解释两句，毕竟团队合作要紧。

可今天她本来就因为二哥的事憋了一肚子火，眼下又被这群老顽固当众冷嘲热讽，耐心彻底耗光。

“各位既然这么瞧不上，那大可以原路返回。只是回去之后，别再对外说你们深耕航母研发了。”

林见微冷笑一声，“攻关十几年，连最基础的入门思路都摸不透，空顶着资历拿不出半点突破，说出来不嫌丢人吗？”

邢龙济的脸色一下子涨成了猪肝色。

“你看看！年纪不大脾气倒不小！京市武研所让一个黄毛丫头当总工，迟早他妈的完蛋。”

“还苍穹？指不定是哪个老专家搞出来的，挂个名在她头上罢了。这种沽名钓誉的事，老子见得多了。”

郑国基也连连摇头，满脸惋惜失望：“年轻气盛、目中无人，纵然有点小聪明，也终究难当大任，不堪造就啊！”

“咱们走！”

邢龙济抄起桌上的文件，拉着郑国基和方志远就往外走。

朱所长连忙追了两步，“老邢、老郑，先别走啊！林总工真是‘苍穹’的总设计师，我还能骗你不成？你们再听听她的思路，哪怕听十分钟……”

几人脚步没停。

“所长，让他们走吧。”林见微不紧不慢说：“没他们，我一样能研发出航母，到时候，他们就等着打脸吧。”

朱所长看看林见微，又看看门口那几位专家，再看回林见微。

他是知道林见微的脾气的，这丫头从来不说没把握的话。

她能说出这话，怎么着也得有一半以上的把握。

朱所长索性也不拉了，靠在门框上，冲那几个人的背影不咸不淡地说了一句：

“老郑，你要走就走吧，到时候可别怪我没给你这个机会。”

赵淑英也站了出来，“林总工的本事放在整个科研界，有几个不知道的？你们要是连坐下来听她说两句的耐心都没有，可见你们孤陋寡闻、肆意偏见！”

郑国基脚步顿了一下，犹豫了。

他原本以为朱所长是故意夸大，可看朱盛宏和赵淑英这般笃定的模样，又不像在说笑。

难道这个看着年轻稚嫩的小姑娘，真有什么不得了的本事？

他们本来就是来商讨航母的，坐了两天的火车，带着几年的研究成果和十几箱资料，巴巴地从江城赶到京市来，连话都没跟人家说上几句就走，是不是太武断了？

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the past, Lin Jianwei might have patiently explained a few sentences, after all, teamwork is important.

But today, she had been holding back her anger because of her second brother, and now she was being ridiculed in public by these stubborn old men, and her patience was completely exhausted.

"Since you all look down upon us so much, you can go back the same way you came. But after you go back, don't tell anyone that you are deeply engaged in aircraft carrier research and development."

Lin Jianwei sneered, "After more than ten years of research, I can't even figure out the most basic entry-level ideas. I can't make any breakthrough despite my qualifications. Isn't it embarrassing to say it?"

Xing Longji's face suddenly turned the color of pig liver.

"Look! He's young but has a bad temper! If the Beijing Military Academy lets a yellow-haired girl be the chief engineer, he'll be damned sooner or later."

"Return to the sky? Maybe some old expert did it and put a name on her head. I've seen this kind of fame-seeking thing a lot."

Zheng Guoji also shook his head repeatedly, with a face full of regret and disappointment: "Young and energetic, arrogant, even if you are a little smart, you will never be able to take on a big responsibility and you will not be able to be promoted!"

"Let's go!"

Xing Longji picked up the documents on the table, took Zheng Guoji and Fang Zhiyuan and walked out.

Director Zhu quickly chased after him, "Old Xing, Old Zheng, don't leave yet! Chief Engineer Lin is really the chief designer of Sky, can I still lie to you? Listen to her ideas again, even if you listen for ten minutes..."

Several people kept walking.

"Director, let them go." Lin Jianwei said calmly: "Without them, I can still develop an aircraft carrier. When the time comes, they will just be waiting to be slapped in the face."

Director Zhu looked at Lin Jianwei, then at the experts at the door, and then back at Lin Jianwei.

He knew Lin Jianwei's temper. This girl never said anything uncertain.

For her to be able to say this, she must be more than half sure.

Director Zhu simply gave up and leaned against the door frame and said to the backs of those people:

"Old Zheng, if you want to leave, just leave. Then don't blame me for not giving you this chance."

Zhao Shuying also stood up, "In the entire scientific research community, how many of you don't know what Chief Engineer Lin is capable of? If you don't even have the patience to sit down and listen to her say a few words, it shows that you are ignorant and wantonly biased!"

Zheng Guoji paused and hesitated.

He originally thought that Director Zhu was exaggerating on purpose, but seeing how determined Zhu Shenghong and Zhao Shuying looked, it didn't look like they were joking.

Could it be that this little girl who looks young and immature really has something extraordinary?

They originally came to discuss the aircraft carrier. After two days of train ride, carrying several years of research results and more than a dozen boxes of information, they rushed from Jiangcheng to Beijing, and left without even saying a few words to others. Isn't it too arbitrary?
